datasets.purpose: IPC Classification spatial data in different IPC scenarios collected by FEWS NET enumerators on a regular schedule (typically monthly).

lineage.description: FEWS NET enumerators conducted regular (typically monthly) field assessments across Zambia to classify acute food insecurity using the IPC framework. Geographic data representing IPC classifications were collected for February, June, and October 2016 and compiled into spatial datasets (GeoJSON/KML format) with classification scales, scenarios, and assistance eligibility indicators.
